description: How a job is to be bound to the cores of its execution host.
Holds what the user asked for with `qsub -binding`: the strategy, how much to bind, and the starting point. What was actually granted is recorded on the granted destination identifier.

attributes.name: amount
description: Number of units to bind to

attributes.name: unit
attributes.summary: Unit type that should be bound
description: Defines if threads, cores, sockets ... should be bound

attributes.name: filter
attributes.summary: Mask that defines which parts of a topology should not be bound
description: Masked parts have to be lowercase in the topology string.

attributes.name: sort
description: Defines how units within the topology string should be sorted before binding.

attributes.name: start
description: Defines the start position for binding within the topology string.

attributes.name: stop
description: Defines the stop position for binding within the topology string.

attributes.name: strategy
description: Defines the strategy for binding, like linear, striding, packed or explicit

attributes.name: specific_hostname
attributes.summary: hostname of where the attributes specific_binding is valid for
description: Used in scheduler only to identify where a specific binding decision was done for.

attributes.name: specific_binding
attributes.summary: A specific binding decision for a job on a host
description: Used in scheduler only to hold a binding decision for a specific job on a host.

attributes.name: specific_binding_list
attributes.summary: Sublist of individual task specific bindings.
description: Id of sublist specifies a task ID and the string the binding done for that task.
Exists only if task specific binding decisions have to be done.

attributes.name: joker
description: Placeholder which can be used for arbitrary data.
Its purpose is to be able to add new attributes without changing the spooling format.
It is a list of arbitrary type and it is spooled.
